text:
This is the other Elias Pettersson: the 22-year-old defenseman from Vasteras, Sweden, a third-round pick in 2022, not the center. In his third NHL season he is playing 18.6 minutes a night on a Vancouver blue line that needs bodies, with 45 hits and 31 blocked shots in 20 games.

He has three goals and four points, but the goals are running ahead of the chances. His three goals came on 1.11 expected goals, and 16.7% shooting will settle. His wins added ranks 166th of 521 skaters, which says the goals he scored came at important moments.

The defensive side is the worry. Vancouver has 41.4% of expected goals with him on at five on five, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting more chances with him on in 2025-26 (bottom 2% of defensemen), though it also noted he played with weaker teammates than almost anyone. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged his exits: 31% keep possession. On a Canucks team that has lost nine of his last ten games, the minutes are there. The job now is to make them cleaner.
headline: The other Elias Pettersson is scoring on defense
